scenario: Two rules emitting the same keyed logical fact (multi-justification) must coalesce to ONE working-memory fact. The second emit coalesces to the existing rete fact (LFAC.1.7). A runtime that builds a SECOND DS wrapper for it double-counts the fact (3 instead of 2) and orphans a wrapper on a later TMS retract. fact_count_after = 2 (Trig + one Mark), not 3.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key
schema Mark scope logical:
    step: String key
rule r1:
    Trig
->
    emit Mark logical step: "X"
rule r2:
    Trig
->
    emit Mark logical step: "X"
